workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've checked Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when BOTH are free (need 30-min slot):

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Can you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these slots? Please let me know which of these times work for both of them too.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Alison, I checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against your proposed slots. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots you provided work for both Elena and David:

- Monday 9:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Both are busy
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both are busy
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David is busy entire slot, Elena busy 15:30-16:00
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy (Hiring panel)
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both are busy

Here are the times when BOTH Elena and David are free (need 30-min slot):
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Could you check if Priya and Marcus are free during any of these times?

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've cross-referenced your slots with Priya and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately NONE of them work:

- Monday 11:00-12:00: Priya is busy (Travel 11:00-11:30, Contract review 11:30-12:00)
- Tuesday 09:00-10:00: Both Priya and Marcus are busy
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00: Both Priya and Marcus are busy
- Thursday 09:30-10:00: Priya is busy
- Thursday 14:30-15:30: Marcus is busy (Dentist 14:30-15:00)
- Friday 15:00-16:00: Both Priya and Marcus are busy

I've double-checked my original analysis. The times when Priya AND Marcus are both free are:
- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

There is NO overlap between when Priya+Marcus are free and when Elena+David are free. This means there is no 30-minute slot next week when all four partners are available.

Can you confirm your analysis of Elena and David's calendars? If you confirm there's truly no overlap, we'll need to report this as infeasible.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Alison, I've carefully re-verified my analysis of Elena and David's calendars. My list of when BOTH are free is correct:

- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

And I confirm there is absolutely NO overlap with your list of when Priya and Marcus are both free:
- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

The intersection is empty. There is no 30-minute slot next week when all four partners are available. I will now report this as infeasible.

infeasible.reason: After cross-referencing all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute time slot next week (Monday Nov 16 - Friday Nov 20, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM Eastern) when Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor are all available. The times when Priya and Marcus are free do not overlap at all with the times when Elena and David are free.
